name: GALAXY ANGEL Moonlit Lovers
source:
Moonlit Lovers, revolves around the battles with remnants of Eonia's forces led by General Rezum and later a mysterious woman named Nefyuuria who claimed to be a member of a race called the Val-Fasq. A new member of the Angel-tai, Karasuma Chitose, is also introduced.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Galaxy_Angel#Galaxy_Angel_Moonlit_Lovers]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
《Moonlit Lovers》围绕着对抗艾欧尼亚残余势力的战斗展开。残军起初由雷佐姆将军统率，之后则由一名自称属于巴鲁·法斯克族的神秘女性涅芙莉亚领导。此外，乌丸千岁也会作为天使队的新成员登场。

[编辑自[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Galaxy_Angel#Galaxy_Angel_Moonlit_Lovers]Wikipedia[/url]]
